title: echium echioides
intro: Echium echioides, commonly known as Pride of Madeira or Viper's Bugloss, is a flowering plant species native to the Atlantic islands. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which aid in treating various conditions like wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Echium echioides include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exert a potential antiviral effect, making it a valuable herbal remedy. Bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, contribute to the plant's medicinal properties, demonstrating its potential in traditional and modern medicine.
